content_blocks.title: Apply the idea
content_blocks.text: Apply Importing Data with SQL Statements to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code:
-- Use a disposable schema and a deliberately selected file location.
LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE 'sample.csv'
INTO TABLE lab_import
FIELDS TERMINATED BY ','
OPTIONALLY ENCLOSED BY '"'
LINES TERMINATED BY '\n'
IGNORE 1 LINES;
content_blocks.expected_output: When permitted and correctly configured, rows from the CSV are loaded; LOCAL INFILE policy and file path must be checked first.

content_blocks.title: Version, security, and safety note
content_blocks.text: Use MySQL 9.7 LTS documentation as the default stable-track reference; verify behavior against MySQL 26.7 documentation when relevant and label any MySQL 8.4-specific fact. common_mistakes.fix: Use a disposable lab, preview targets and permissions, and write a reset/recovery plan before executing.
